label: Transmission (Mendel, horizontal transfer)
text: BI.O.A1.3 Transmission. Mendel's laws: segregation holds for a diploid locus under regular meiosis; independent assortment holds only for loci that are unlinked. Linkage is the exception that maps chromosomes. Horizontal gene transfer moves sequence between lineages and breaks a strictly branching tree. Plasmids are its common vehicle in prokaryotes.

warrant.standard: Replicated cross or edit; sequencing with stated error rate; independent lab confirmation
warrant.defeaters: Contamination; off-target edits; annotation error; linkage mistaken for causation
